next_question.rationale: Most evidence points at a payments-page abandonment concentrated in consumer flows: "customer went back from payments page" = 3,520 and the top gap is 4,804 lost bookings. Consumer and direct channels convert poorly (b2c 993 of 5,777 = 17.19%; halodoc_customer 652 of 5,193 = 12.56%) while corporate channels convert well. I expect one or two lead-time buckets (for example, same-day or very short lead times) to show much lower conversion from "started a booking" to "chose a slot and confirmed" than others — perhaps because urgent/same-day bookings hit payment time pressure, app timeouts, or provider availability and are more likely to be abandoned at the payments page. If true, that will localise the failure to a narrow booking type we can fix or route differently (e.g., simplify payment or offer a hold option) and explain a large share of the 4,804 lost bookings.
